name: Seated Rear Delt Fly
research: Flat bench (deg 0); sit on its seat end (seat spans y -0.35..-0.01, top 0.44). Root (0,-0.22,0.47): seated root 0.494 in the proven press, ~2 cm lower because the pelvis tilts forward. Lean: root rot X +45 (+X = forward) plus spine +4 x4 -> torso ~60 deg from vertical, back kept flat (ACE); neck/head -15 to keep the gaze neutral. Hip then ~(0.11,-0.25,0.45); ankles (+-0.09,-0.72,0.074): hip-ankle 0.59 m -> knee ~80 deg, clear of the bench foot rail at y -0.48. Shoulders land over the knees (~0.43 forward, 0.2 up from the hip) = chest near knees. Torso frame for a 60 deg lean: world down = (0, 0.87, -0.5) torso -> a hanging arm is elev 60 / plane 90; used elev 70 / plane 80 so hands hang ~0.1 m outside the shoulders (x ~0.32) and the plates (r 0.088) clear the calves (x <= 0.16). Hand ~0.57 below the shoulder (z ~0.66) -> z ~0.1, plates just off the floor. Neutral axis start = world forward (thumbs toward the toes) in torso = (0, cos lean, sin lean); [0, 0.42, 0.91] assumes the lean lands nearer 65 deg (rest-pose spine adds a few degrees) - square to the hanging forearm either way within ~5 deg. End elev 88 / plane 0 = arm square to the torso, horizontal (elbows at shoulder height), palms down, thumbs toward the head [0,0,1]. Elbow fixed 15. S1 Sweeney 2014 (ACE seated rear lateral raise), S2 Schoenfeld 2013 (neutral grip).
